name: Izzy & Fiona's Room
body:
Mirror-panelled doors and a shared balcony view of the orchard, a linked lighting charm adjusting tone to time of day. Twin-set lingerie folded in perfect symmetry on the dresser. Perfume bottles arranged by hue on a vanity mirror that stays warm and fog-free from wiring they installed themselves.

Sea-salt and copper perfume, soft amber light tinting every reflection — unmistakably Harlow. These two walked into Haven already married, already devoted, already leaking the kind of twin energy that makes the house hotter simply by existing.

THEIR ROOM DOES NOT NEED TO PROVE ANYTHING. It just IS.
